WITH c AS (SELECT customer, SUM(subtotal) s FROM orders WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY customer),
n AS (SELECT CAST(CEIL(COUNT(*)*0.1) AS INT) k, COUNT(*) total FROM c),
r AS (SELECT s, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s DESC) rn FROM c)
SELECT (SELECT SUM(s) FROM r, n WHERE rn<=k)*1.0/(SELECT SUM(s) FROM c) share, k, total,
(SELECT s FROM r, n WHERE rn=k) kth, (SELECT s FROM r, n WHERE rn=k+1) next, (SELECT MAX(ordered_at) FROM orders) mx FROM n

WITH c AS (SELECT customer, SUM(subtotal) s FROM orders WHERE ordered_at >= '2025-01-01' AND ordered_at < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY customer),
n AS (SELECT CAST(CEIL(COUNT(*)*0.1) AS INT) k, COUNT(*) total FROM c),
r AS (SELECT s, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY s DESC) rn FROM c)
SELECT (SELECT SUM(s) FROM r, n WHERE rn<=k)*1.0/(SELECT SUM(s) FROM c) AS top_share, k, total,
(SELECT s FROM r, n WHERE rn=k) kth, (SELECT s FROM r, n WHERE rn=k+1) nxt, (SELECT MAX(ordered_at) FROM orders) mx FROM n
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM orders WHERE customer IS NULL
